continuation.description:
A continuation token.
If the success response contains a continuation token, the list contains more designs
you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more
designs from the list, for example
`/v1/designs?continuation={continuation}`.

To retrieve all of a user's designs, you might need to make multiple requests.

Design.description: The design object, which contains metadata about the design.

created_at.description:
When the design was created in Canva, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix
Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the design was last updated in Canva, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the
Unix Epoch).

page_count.description: The total number of pages in the design. Some design types don't have pages (for example, Canva docs).

design_types.description: The type of content a design or page contains. The list of design types may grow over time. The `unknown` value represents design types that haven't been added to the list.

DesignLinks.description: A temporary set of URLs for viewing or editing the design.

edit_url.description:
A temporary editing URL for the design. This URL is only accessible to the user that made the API request, and is designed to support [return navigation](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/return-navigation-guide/) workflows.

NOTE: This is not a permanent URL, it is only valid for 30 days.

view_url.description:
A temporary viewing URL for the design. This URL is only accessible to the user that made the API request, and is designed to support [return navigation](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/return-navigation-guide/) workflows.

NOTE: This is not a permanent URL, it is only valid for 30 days.

DesignTypeOutputName.description: The type of content a design or page contains. The list of design types may grow over time. The `unknown` value represents design types that haven't been added to the list.

TeamUserSummary.description: Metadata for the user, consisting of the User ID and Team ID.

team_id.description: The ID of the user's Canva Team.

Thumbnail.description: A thumbnail image representing the object.

width.description: The width of the thumbnail image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the thumbnail image in pixels.

url.description:
A URL for retrieving the thumbnail image.
This URL expires after 15 minutes. This URL includes a query string
that's required for retrieving the thumbnail.
